items.title: JPM vs. BAC: The Bank Built to Sustain Dividend Growth When Markets Turn
items.summary: JPMorgan and Bank of America both just raised their dividends and both stocks just slid, but only one has the capital cushion and crisis track record to keep paying through a downturn. Three measures separate a reliable retirement income stream from a fragile one.

items.title: Cramer Says Buy Apple Before New Phone Comes Out. Because Apple’s Duo Model Is, “Kind Of Astounding”
items.summary: Jim Cramer just called Apple's first foldable phone kind of astounding and told followers to buy shares before it ships, but a closer look at supply constraints, memory costs, and a one-time earnings boost raises real questions about whether the Duo can actually move the needle.

items.title: JPMorgan Trades Below 50-Day SMA: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: JPM trades below its 50-day SMA, signaling near-term caution. Still, loan growth, fee revenues and strong capital levels support its outlook. Is it a buy?

items.title: How BofA’s tech summit influences strategy
items.summary: An annual event uniting bank leaders and tech upstarts, happening next week, helps the lender assess how potential partners are innovating, Bank of America’s chief technology and information officer said.

items.title: Paylocity expansion beyond payroll backs Bank of America "buy"

items.title: Disney faces uneven 2027 as Bank of America stays positive
items.summary: Walt Disney Co (NYSE:DIS, XETRA:WDP) retained Bank of America's "buy" rating and $125 price target, as the broker largely maintained its financial year 2027 forecasts while anticipating uneven segment performance. items.title: BofA Raises Odds Of Success For Immix Biopharma’s NXC-201 Therapy — Sees Over 190% Upside In IMMX Stock
items.summary: Immix Biopharma’s latest clinical results showed strong patient responses to its lead CAR-T candidate as the biotech firm prepares for a planned regulatory filing in 2027.

items.title: Apple Falls 2% as Bank of America Flags Meta’s Shopping Agent; Alphabet Slips, Microsoft Holds Steady
items.summary: Bank of America just flagged a Meta shopping agent that could quietly drain the most profitable part of Apple's business, and the gap between Apple's stock drop and the broader tech market suggests investors are taking the warning seriously.
